brief: Automated photo printing app for Filipino print shops. Add photos and obtain print-ready files with the photos formatted at true size. Name from Tagalog silbi: usefulness / being of service. Personality: helpful, reliable, friendly.
requested_size: approximately 1536 × 1536; preserved native 1254 × 1254 output without resampling
generation_method: Six independent OpenAI built-in image_gen calls, one per asset, using three parallel workers; no references, retries, filtering, post-processing or resampling. Every returned result is preserved.
model_note: The built-in tool does not expose model selection and returned only image_url and output_hint; the exact model was not disclosed.

variants.rationale: Dependable, helpful service that carries the photo-formatting work for Filipino print shops.
variants.subject: baby Filipino carabao with an oversized, broad rounded head flowing into a compact shoulder mass, calm widely spaced eyes, and one defining feature: a pair of thick gently curved horns with conspicuously rounded blunt ends, both fully visible
variants.treatment: Make the primary golden mango mass a wide softly squared head and shoulders. Use deep mulberry for the two chunky horns and the two tiny eyes; visually group the horns into a single broad crown region.
